messages:
Tariq - Support: forwarding ticket C-92345 from FinEdge. they need streaming fncall fragments so their payments router can debit earlier. current full-object wait adds ~200ms.

Tariq - Support: customer example: they consume lines of framed json with fields (call_id, idx, final, chunk). they request ordering guarantees and stable frame versioning.

Nina (PM): summary of asks: 1) incremental fncall emit (fragments) 2) versioned json_lines framing + docs 3) Dedicated opt-in + SLA proposal.

Omar (Eng): feasibility: yes for Dedicated via a fast-path on pinned nodes. work required: runtime change to emit fragments earlier, token-boundary mapping, and duplicate/order protection. Hosted parity is larger effort.

Nina (PM): triage options: A) Dedicated opt-in flag + early access (P0) B) Hosted parity next quarter (P2) C) webhook workaround (P3). Recommend A for now.

Omar (Eng): rough ETA for A: 3w eng + 1w infra/canary. spike 3d to validate fragment assembly approach. perf risk: extra small frames -> higher RPCs; mitigate with pinned fast-path.

Nina (PM): proposed SLA for Dedicated preview: 99th pct partial-frame emit latency <60ms under committed capacity. include escalation playbook.

infra-bot: Ticket C-92345 updated: NDA requested: YES. Commitment: PENDING.

Tariq - Support: customer said they'll sign a 12mo if we provide early access and NDA.

Nina (PM): next steps: Nina write 1-pager PRD and add to Dedicated board; Omar to run 3d spike (owner Omar); infra to add metrics: partial_frame.emit.latency, missing_seq. reconvene in 5 days.

Omar (Eng): starting spike today, will post findings in #eng-runtime.

Nina (PM): moving to P0 Dedicated backlog pending NDA. :thumbsup:
